organisation: Estonian Land and Spatial Development Board
inputSpecification:
Current state is 12 bands TIFF raster with GSD 10cm:
- RGBN orthophoto
- RGB true-orthophoto
- nDSM (derived from LiDAR)
- Hillshade (derived from LiDAR)
- Intensity (derived from LiDAR)
- Openness (derived from LiDAR)
- Classes (derived from LiDAR pointcloud classification)

Model is in development, input bands may change
outputSpecification:
4 band TIFF raster with GSD 10cm:
- buildings
- roads
- watercources
- other
architecture: Visual transformer or latest Visual Language models are considered to be used
trainingDataOrigin: Estonian orthophotos and elevation data from 2025. Labels created internally based on reviewed Topographic Database data
